sources.snippet: siglip-base-patch16-224 is a lightweight image classification and multimodal embedding model released by Google. Based on the SigLIP architecture, it excels at image-text alignment and classification tasks. The model performs excellently in image retrieval, visual content understanding, and multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, serving as an ideal foundation for visual AI applications.
